title: Zero product property
text: By the zero product property for fractions, $$\frac{x\left(x-3\right)}{x+2}=0$$ when $$x=0$$ or $$x-3=0$$, which means $$x=0$$ or $$x=3$$.

title: Check denominator
text: We must verify that these values do not make the denominator $$0$$, which would make the expression undefined. The denominator is $$x+2$$, which is nonzero for $$x=0$$ and $$x=3$$, thus both are valid solutions.
